ticket_text: Go to My Orders and click on Request Refund. Refunds take 5 to 7 days after approval.
Check internet and card details, then retry. If payment deducted but order failed, refund arrives in 3 to 5 days.
Check Caps Lock, clear cache, or use another browser.If still failing, click Forgot Password or contact support.
Click Forgot Password, enter email/phone, and follow the link.
Go to Settings then Account click on Deactivate. Data and history will be removed. Reactivate within 30 days or email for permanent deletion.
Open My Orders click on Track Shipment.Use tracking ID for updates. If stuck over 48 hrs, contact support.
Check tracking ID. If marked Delivered but not received, share order ID + address. We'll investigate and arrange replacement/refund.
Go to My Orders click on Cancel before shipment. If shipped, refuse delivery. Refund starts once cancellation confirmed.
Open Subscriptions then Manage Plan click on Renew. Update payment method if failed. For issues, share plan ID.
Restart app, clear cache, and update version.If issue persists, send screenshot to techsupport@company.com
